messages:
Noah: Heads-up - SAPPHIRE Inc's on-prem renewal INV-94012 has platform fee + support split. Their AP flagged it during audit and put payment on hold. Need quick reconcile. :grimacing:
Priyanka: Can you paste the exported lines? is it a true-up or renewal invoice?
Noah: Renewal true-up. Export shows:
```
INV-94012 line items:
- PLATFORM_ANNUAL  85,000.00  GL:PLAT-9001
- SUPPORT_TIER_ADJ 35,000.00  GL:SUP-3002
Total: 120,000.00
```
Contract signed AMND-2024-01 lists a single platform fee 120k that includes support for the year. Customer insists on one line item.
Elliot: Looks like our migration adapter emitted a separate support adjustment instead of folding into platform fee. Two remediation options: 1) credit memo + reissue single-line invoice; 2) journal reclass & alert AR to accept multiple lines. Which is less friction for SAPPHIRE?
Marta: I'm lead on renewals for SAPPHIRE. They want the invoice to match the contract PDF exactly (single line). They'll release payment only when it matches. Option 1 please.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-94012 created at 2034567885 by billing-worker. Status: Pending.
Priyanka: Ok. Proposed path: issue credit memo CM-549 to void SUPPORT_TIER_ADJ line, then issue INV-94012-R1 with single PLATFORM_ANNUAL 120,000 and memo referencing AMND-2024-01. Also post PR-8022 to move GL SUP-3002 -> PLAT-9001 so revenue booking aligns. ETA today EOD if approvals in place.
Elliot: Approving. Please include note: "Preserve original invoice date in memo for customer AP" and tag PR-8022.
Marta: Confirmed with customer on call; they want original invoice date preserved and a short note: "Consolidated per AMND-2024-01". They also asked we email a copy to ap@sapphire.example.
Priyanka: Created CM-549 at 2034567905 and drafted INV-94012-R1. Email to customer queued.
billing-bot: Credit memo CM-549 created at 2034567905 by billing-worker.
Priyanka: PR-8022 posted at 2034568100 linking CM-549 and INV-94012-R1. GL reclass done.
Priyanka: INV-94012-R1 issued at 2034568150. Memo: "Consolidated per AMND-2024-01. Ref: INV-94012". Emailed to ap@sapphire.example.
billing-bot: AR ingest processed at 2034568200. Status: Success.
Noah: AR upload succeeded on our end too. Customer confirmed payment release. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
Marta: I'll add a short remediation ticket for eng-billing: prevent support-tier adj emission when contract consolidation flag true. Filing FR-9150.
Elliot: Thanks team. Quick note for audit trail: reconcile command used: `billing_tool export-lines --invoice INV-94012 --format csv`.
